name: Magura

queries.query: Bangladesh official cadastral parcel map Magura land records DLRS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) public Settlement map application and the Ministry of Land's national digital land-zoning map. The DLRS viewer's current JavaScript exposed anonymous hierarchy, sheet, and parcel-tile routes; no Magura parcel geometry was returned in the bounded requests below.

queries.query: বাংলাদেশ সরকারি মাগুরা মৌজা মানচিত্র ভূমি নকশা
queries.result: The native-language discovery identified the same official DLRS map-search route and the Ministry of Land's ভূমি নকশা project. Search results describe digitized/georeferenced mouza and plot maps, but did not expose a Magura-specific public parcel download or safe parcel response.

registryEvidence.custodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh; public Settlement map application.
registryEvidence.localEvidence: The official hierarchy returned Khulna division, Magura district, and an RS survey record. It did not return a Magura upazila/map-unit record in the bounded anonymous request, so local parcel-registry evidence is not sufficient to set registryFound=true.
registryEvidence.scope: The Ministry of Land project page is national project prose and was not treated as city-local registry evidence. The DLRS viewer is the first-party operational route inspected.

parcelDiscovery.source: Official DLRS Settlement map application only; no retained sample.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 HTML received. Current MapSearch.js configuration exposed the public POST hierarchy routes, sheet GeoJSON route, and parcel vector-tile/meta routes.
An empty POST initially returned HTTP 411 Length Required; retry with Content-Length: 0 returned the division list, including Khulna unitcod 020000000.
With divid=020000000, returned Magura district unitcod 020200000 and comcod 4166.
With districtid=020200000 and comcod=4166, returned one RS survey record: rsnum 201901, labelled আর. এস. / RS, status চলমান.
With comcod=4166, rsno1=201901, districtid=020200000, returned an empty JSON list. No upazila, mouza, sheet, or parcel route could be safely parameterized from this response.
With unitcode=020200000, returned a Magura district MultiPolygon boundary response. This is administrative boundary evidence, not parcel geometry, and was not retained as a sample.
Returned HTTP 200 catalog JSON with general raster overlay entries; no Magura-specific parcel layer was listed.
HTTP 200 Ministry of Land project page received. It describes digitized/georeferenced mouza and plot maps and exposes selectors, but no safe Magura parcel response was obtained.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point [23.489161857775, 89.4198176255085] was preserved and not shifted. No exact-point parcel query was possible after the empty upazila response. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, khatiyan/rights, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

uncertainty: The empty RS upazila response may reflect incomplete digitization, route/data availability, or survey coverage; it is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The returned administrative boundary does not establish parcel coverage at the immutable WUP point.
Packet completion records executed discovery and request attempts only; it is not source integration or runtime adapter admission.
